name: Dumbbell Decline Bench Press
steps: Set an adjustable bench to a decline, hook your legs under the foot pads, and lie back with dumbbells.
Start with the dumbbells above your shoulders, palms facing your feet and shoulder blades supported on the bench.
Bend your elbows slightly angled from your torso to lower the dumbbells beside your chest.
Press both dumbbells smoothly back above your shoulders until your arms straighten.
tips: Keep your forearms vertical and wrists stacked over your elbows at the bottom.
Lower under control instead of bouncing the dumbbells off your lower chest.
